macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: Hotter-than-expected inflation pressures stocks and raises Fed hike bets
items.summary: U.S. stocks fell after October CPI rose 0.4% month over month, above the 0.3% forecast, while core CPI increased 0.3%. The Dow dropped 0.3%, the S&P 500 fell 0.4%, and the Nasdaq declined 0.7%; Treasury yields rose sharply as markets priced greater odds of a December rate increase.[1][2]

items.title: Fed Governor Waller opens door to 50-basis-point December hike
items.summary: Christopher Waller said he supports a 25-basis-point increase at the Federal Reserve’s December meeting and that a 50-basis-point move should be considered if inflation remains elevated. His comments intensified pressure on equities and lifted the 10-year Treasury yield toward 4.99%.[2][6]

items.title: Anthropic reportedly targets valuation of roughly $1.3 trillion
items.summary: Anthropic disclosed in a U.S. regulatory filing that it is seeking to sell shares at a valuation of approximately $1.3 trillion, adding a major technology-financing development amid renewed investor focus on artificial-intelligence companies.[1]

items.title: CoreWeave earnings become key test for AI infrastructure demand
items.summary: Cloud infrastructure company CoreWeave was scheduled to report quarterly results after the market close, with investors focused on data-center capacity, financing needs and the profitability of continued AI infrastructure expansion.[4][10]

items.title: Unity reports stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue
items.summary: Unity reported fourth-quarter revenue of $609 million, up 35% year over year and above the consensus estimate of $562.71 million.[8]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly tests $73,600 amid broader market weakness
items.summary: Bitcoin briefly retraced to approximately $73,600 as the Nasdaq 100 fell 1.5%, reflecting continued pressure across risk assets.

items.title: INIT surges more than 100% in 24 hours
items.summary: INIT rose to about $0.275, with reported 24-hour gains exceeding 110% amid a sharp increase in trading volume.

items.title: USDC Treasury issues $250 million on Solana
items.summary: The USDC Treasury issued 250 million USDC on the Solana blockchain, representing approximately $250 million in newly issued stablecoins.

items.title: Japan regulator seeks halt to unregistered Bitcoin ETF promotions
items.summary: Japan’s Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission petitioned a Tokyo court to stop three unregistered firms accused of pitching a Bitcoin ETF to 2,141 investors.

items.title: IMF urges Kenya to implement crypto Travel Rule
items.summary: The IMF reportedly urged Kenya to require crypto companies to collect, verify and share transaction-participant information under the FATF Travel Rule to strengthen anti-money-laundering controls.

items.title: Hyperliquid burns $2.08 million of HYPE tokens
items.summary: Hyperliquid bought back and burned 28,500 HYPE tokens within 24 hours; the project says cumulative burns have reached about 50.42 million tokens.

items.title: Solana prepares Direct Mapping mainnet launch
items.summary: A Solana Foundation developer-relations official said Direct Mapping will soon launch on mainnet and advised developers to test applications against the feature before deployment.

items.title: Nasdaq raises concerns about SEC tokenization approach
items.summary: Nasdaq expressed concerns about the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s approach to implementing tokenized securities on blockchain infrastructure.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: GTA 6 preload begins ahead of November 19 launch
items.summary: Rockstar and PlayStation released a new short trailer and opened digital preload for Grand Theft Auto VI on PS5. The game is scheduled to launch globally on November 19.

items.title: Sony cancels Fairgames live-service shooter
items.summary: Sony reportedly canceled Fairgames, the PS5 and PC multiplayer shooter from Haven Studios, after testing showed mixed player feedback and retention results amid difficult conditions for the PvP market.

items.title: Take-Two says legacy franchises are being revived
items.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick said the company is working on reviving several legacy franchises, though no specific titles were identified.

items.title: AI-assisted games reach roughly half of new Steam releases
items.summary: Approximately half of the games newly released on Steam in October used generative AI in areas such as programming, artwork, voice lines, or other production tasks, intensifying debate over AI’s role in game development.

items.title: Marathon Symbiosis update announced for December
items.summary: Bungie’s Marathon will receive the Symbiosis update on December 8, adding new PvE and PvP modes, weapons, and other content.

items.title: Troy Baker to receive New York Game Awards legend honor
items.summary: Voice actor Troy Baker has been selected for the Andrew Yoon Legend Award at the 2027 New York Game Awards, recognizing his extensive work across games, television, and film.

items.title: EA classics arrive on Steam
items.summary: A new Steam release collection includes 25 classic Electronic Arts titles, including Road Rash and Wing Commander, according to a gaming industry news roundup.
